scope.scannerPackageSet: Package, lockfile, and source indicators for pre-execution review.
scope.currentCampaignContext: OX Security reported a DPRK-linked npm infostealer/RAT campaign involving terminal-logger-utils and dependent packages pretty-logger-utils, ts-logger-pack, and pinno-loggers. GitHub Advisory GHSA-m3gw-x6rc-fp3r reports csc154-internall-depend as npm malware with all versions affected. GitHub Advisory GHSA-vqg9-785x-8j39 reports @validate-sdk/v2 as npm malware with all versions affected. GitHub Advisory GHSA-g6v5-9xpp-6hpx reports google-cloud-secret-manager-config-poc as npm malware with all versions affected. Panther reports an April 2026 OtterCookie npm campaign using wrapper/payload packages with exact malicious versions and Vercel-hosted C2 infrastructure. JFrog reports Solana FakeFix and CMS Windows loader npm/PyPI packages targeting Solana keys, SSH keys, cloud credentials, source-control tokens, wallet files, and Windows persistence. Socket reports GlassWASM trojanized Open VSX extensions using suspicious WASM payloads, TinyGo/WebAssembly host code, Solana memo dead-drop retrieval, and child-process download/execute loaders. BleepingComputer reported Aikido findings on malicious JetBrains Marketplace plugins stealing AI API keys and exfiltrating to 39.107.60[.]51/api/software/key. This checker detects those package/plugin names and selected behavior indicators. OX Security reported the June 17, 2026 easy-day-js / Mastra npm supply-chain attack affecting 141 packages through a malicious dayjs dependency swap, postinstall setup.cjs execution, and crypto-stealer C2 indicators. Socket later published stage-2 easy-day-js / Mastra details, including protocal.cjs, nvmconf.service, NodePackages persistence, Hostwinds C2 hostnames, /update/49890878, wallet-extension inventory behavior, browser-history collection, and SHA-256 hashes. SafeDep reported a June 16, 2026 procwire / routecraft npm campaign in which five coordinated packages split a Windows-only preinstall dropper across procwire, routecraft, endpointmap, bytecraft, and staticlayer, reconstructing a catbox.moe payload URL, using Microsoft-Delivery-Optimization/10.0, curl.exe, bitsadmin, hidden process execution, and Mark-of-the-Web stripping. JFrog's June 18, 2026 npm v12 trust-model analysis reinforces this pre-execution lane: allowScripts, --allow-git, and --allow-remote move npm from implicit execution/retrieval to explicit approvals, but approvals should be version-pinned, temporary, and re-evaluated because attackers can target already-approved packages or move logic to runtime/import-time paths. Microsoft published AutoJack research on a local AI-agent/browser-to-localhost control-plane RCE pattern in AutoGen Studio, fixed in GitHub main at commit b047730. The Hacker News reported that autogenstudio pre-release builds 0.4.3.dev1 and 0.4.3.dev2 contained the vulnerable MCP WebSocket handler, while the stable PyPI build 0.4.2.2 did not include that route. This checker flags those pre-release references and selected AutoJack local MCP control-plane indicators for review.
